name: Heir Accedes
summary: The old head's time ends, and the heir takes the seat. The renown of the one who came before fades to a gentler glow as a new generation begins its own story.
comment: Concordia Phase 15 — bespoke cinematic for player heir takeover (Phase 12). New head accedes; previous head's renown attrites to 0.7×; generation counter advances.
